name: Forerunner K2
summary:
Forerunner K2 is Kepler's general-purpose humanoid platform within its Forerunner development range. Kepler presents the family around human-shaped movement, visual perception, coordinated hand control and physical work in industrial settings.

The current K2 presentation emphasizes sustained work and charging, while the broader Forerunner page describes a configurable combination of manipulation and mobility. Family-level specifications should be checked against the particular K2 configuration before comparison, since published materials cover more than one stage of the programme. Industrial
